description.value: An American customer relationship management (CRM) firm headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
HubSpot, Inc. is an American customer relationship management (CRM) company.
HubSpot sells a customer platform of marketing, sales, service and AI software that brings together teams, tools, AI and customer data.
A Cambridge, Massachusetts software company that sells a CRM platform organized as hubs, such as Marketing Hub, Sales Hub and Service Hub, all tied to a central CRM.

A Cambridge, Massachusetts-based software company, founded in 2006 by Brian Halligan and Dharmesh Shah, whose core offering is a cloud-based CRM platform with hubs for marketing, sales, service, content management, operations, commerce and data.

product_description.value: Marketing Hub, Sales Hub, Service Hub, Content Hub, Data Hub, Revenue Hub, Smart CRM (AI-powered, with a free CRM tier), Agent Hub for building AI agents, a Small Business Bundle of Starter editions, AEO (Beta) for tracking brand visibility in AI results, and a Marketplace of third-party app integrations.
Marketing, sales and service tools, including HubSpot AI, Sales Hub, Service Hub and Marketing Hub.
Hubs on a shared CRM foundation (HubSpot Smart CRM): Marketing, Sales, Service, Content, Operations, Commerce and Data Hub.
A CRM platform with hubs such as Marketing Hub, Sales Hub and Service Hub, covering marketing, sales, customer service, content management, operations, commerce and website tools.

business_model_description.value: Sells software; early growth relied on free online tools for inbound marketing.

Primarily subscription-based, with tiered pricing plans and a freemium approach that lets customers start with free tools and upgrade. Consulting services and hosting events are a smaller revenue stream.

customer_description.value: More than 306,000 customers worldwide. Named customers include eBay, DoorDash, Reddit, Tripadvisor, Eventbrite, Unipart and Angel City FC.
Started with small companies and moved upmarket to serve larger businesses of up to 1,000 employees, per Forbes.
Mid-market B2B businesses and enterprises, plus smaller companies that use the free CRM tier.
